# Cooke Optics

> > Manufacturer of premium cinema lenses renowned for the distinctive 'Cooke Look' used in feature films and television production worldwide.

Cooke Optics produces spherical, anamorphic, macro, and zoom lenses including the S7/i FF, S8/i FF, Anamorphic/i S35, Panchro/i Classic, and SP3 series. The company pioneered i/Technology for lens metadata and offers the Lens Display System for professional cinematography.

## Key Topics

- Cooke Look
- Anamorphic/i S35 lenses
- S7/i FF and S8/i FF lenses
- i/Technology lens metadata
- Spherical prime lenses
- Panchro/i Classic series
- SP3 Speed Panchro
- Macro/i FF lenses
- Lens Display System
- Cinematography Electronics
- Visual storytelling
- Film production workflows
- Sony Venice 2 compatibility
- ASC cinematographers
- Special Flair coating

- [Sistema de Visualización](https://cookeoptics.com/es/sistema-de-visualizacion): i/Lens Display System for focus distance and metadata monitoring
